_notes.mode: 'absolute' = compute read height from table_z_mm + reader height + gap (recommended, robust). 'relative' = adjust a reference descent by the height difference (use only if you don't want to calibrate the table).
_notes.table_z_mm: ABSOLUTE Z of the table surface in the robot base frame, in mm. CALIBRATE ONCE: jog the TCP (with card mounted) down until it just touches the bare table, then read get_position()[1][2] and put that value here.
_notes.default_read_gap_mm: Air gap to hold the card ABOVE the top of the reader during the read. 0 = card resting on the reader. Override per reader if needed.
_notes.staging_angle_deg: Joint angles (6 values) for the pose the arm starts from, positioned above the reader before descending. Override per reader if readers sit at different table positions.
_notes.reference_*: Only used in 'relative' mode. reference_descent_mm is the descent that lands the card correctly for a reader of reference_height_mm. The script then adjusts descent by the height difference for other readers.
